findings.description: The caption states 4 leaves of 0.305 x 2.400 x 0.035 m in hollow_core and a total of 5.5 kg. The stated area density is 7.2 kg/m2, so those leaves weigh 21 kg between them: the slab mass has been computed for one leaf and then split across all 4. Every leaf is 4x too light.
findings.where: caption; the leaves in panels 1 and 2
